name: THE VISIT
blurb: Gatsby asks Nick to prepare his house for Daisy's visit. Mow the backyard and arrange the daisies he loves.
how: First-person · WASD / arrow keys walk · mouse or IJKL look · Mow every row of the marked lawn · Left click a daisy, then left click an outlined vase · ESC for chapters

models.format: glb or gltf; keep source files in assets/3d/ and copy runtime files into the frontend public root

win.title: A GARDEN FOR DAISY
win.body: Nick mowed every row and placed the daisies around his little West Egg home. Gatsby's money bought a beautiful afternoon, and Daisy would find the garden waiting.
win.quote: I hope she'll be a fool — that's the best thing a girl can be in this world, a beautiful little fool.
win.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby

lose.title: A GARDEN STILL WAITING
lose.body: The lawn still has uncut rows and the vases are waiting for daisies. Gatsby's offer remains on the table whenever Nick is ready to finish.
lose.quote: I hope she'll be a fool — that's the best thing a girl can be in this world, a beautiful little fool.
lose.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby
